about_the_game:
Game Background

Construction worker Chen Lin, after finishing his night shift, suddenly finds himself caught in a series of bizarre events—his girlfriend Jiayi has gone missing, strange dolls appear out of nowhere, and he is inexplicably chased by "Jiayi." Yet, what hidden story lies behind these eerie occurrences?

Gameplay

This demo encompasses the core gameplay of the full version—a story-driven horror puzzle game. In this demo, you’ll experience the first chapter: Apartment, which serves as an introduction to the overarching narrative. Through puzzle-solving—such as finding keys, examining sticky notes, diaries, documents, and other items—you’ll uncover Chen Lin’s backstory. Additionally, you’ll face the thrill of escaping "Jiayi’s" pursuit. Be warned: you may lack defensive tools, so stay alert! Listen carefully—footsteps may be approaching. Avoid detection to keep exploring!

Demo Introduction

The full game is planned to have five chapters, with this demo showcasing the first: Apartment. The art style is realistic with a modern Chinese aesthetic. While the storyline is complete, the visuals are still being polished. Welcome to try it out! The demo is expected to release on May 1st—stay tuned!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7-3770 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）

short_description: "Chase & Escape" is a single-player horror game about Chen Lin, a construction worker. After his night shift, his girlfriend Jiayi vanishes, strange dolls appear, and he’s chased by her. What’s behind these eerie events? Discover the truth!
